note: Set A is better because it correctly identifies the '1" FLEX' line as a Water Supply line, whereas Set B misbinds it to Fire Sprinklers. Set B suffers from significant duplication, with four claims essentially stating the Fire Sprinklers are 1" CPVC. Set A has one incorrect claim (binding 30 FT length to the Reel instead of the East Module) and misses the specific Dishwasher diameter found in Set B, but its overall fidelity and lack of redundancy make it superior.
remarks: Set B's extraction of the Dishwasher diameter (3/4") is a positive detail that Set A missed. However, Set B's repetition of the Fire Sprinkler CPVC claim (4 times) significantly degrades its quality according to the preference for fewer trivial/duplicate claims.
